nodes.text: The world has great trust in us, consul. This will open up many opportunities for us.
nodes.speaker: Tacitus

nodes.text: The world is indifferent to us, consul. We must do what we can to improve the favor of other nations.
nodes.speaker: Tacitus

choices.text: I will see to it, Tacitus.

nodes.text: The world has little trust in us, consul. We must do what we can to improve the favor of other nations.
nodes.speaker: Tacitus

choices.text: I will see to it, Tacitus.
